system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes seated in a small wicker chair in a corner, sharply attentive, with Dr. Watson standing nearby and Helen Stoner watching from the doorway","action":"Holmes's eyes travel slowly over the walls and ceiling while he asks about the thick bell-rope hanging beside the bed, its tassel resting on the pillow","setting":"Small low-ceilinged whitewashed bedroom with gaping fireplace, worm-eaten brown oak panelling, square Wilton carpet, narrow white bed, brown chest of drawers, dressing-table by the window","secondaryElements":"Two small wicker chairs, the bell-rope with tassel on the pillow, a side door opening onto a whitewashed corridor, dull grey window light","mood":"Quiet, tense, observant, gaslit intimacy with dry restraint","timeOfDay":"Daytime, overcast","composition":"Medium interior shot from the doorway, Holmes in the corner at left, bed and bell-rope centre-right, window light falling across the carpet"}
